profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack Software Engineer and Architect specializing in designing scalable, high-impact cloud solutions that optimize efficiency and usability. With deep expertise in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and software architecture, I thrive in transforming concepts into concrete implementations that drive business growth and technical excellence.

Over the past decade, I’ve tackled data visualization, analytics, and rapid prototyping, leveraging Agile methodologies to navigate complex projects. I mentor engineering teams, lead architectural initiatives, and foster continuous improvement in engineering culture, ensuring robust, adaptable solutions.

Beyond work, I’m passionate about software innovation, IoT experimentation, and game development, with two published titles across major platforms. Whether building cutting-edge cloud systems or crafting engaging digital experiences, I’m driven by precision, efficiency, and creativity.

positions.title: Founder, Developer
positions.description:
• Entrepreneurial Spirit: Founded an indie game/web development studio, delivering positively reviewed titles and web solutions that showcase holistic expertise in design, UI/UX, and full-stack development. Two published game titles are available in app stores.

• 2D Game Development: Partnered with artist/designer to create a 2D physics-puzzler 'Cockatilt' in Unity3D/C#, performing all gameplay, UI programming, animation, sound, and deployment resulting in a published game with reviews rating over 4.5/5 and over 5K downloads.

• 3D Game Development: Published 'Congruity' - A simple 3D puzzle game in Unity3D based loosely on the concept of "Lights out" including all artwork, 3D modeling, design, gameplay, UI, animation, sound, particles, and deployment.


Play Congruity: http://smarturl.it/congruity?IQid=linkedin
Play Cockatilt: http://smarturl.it/cockatilt?IQid=linkedin
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · Architecture · Game Development · C# · Unity3D · Angular Material · TypeScript · Git · JavaScript

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE-III)
positions.description:
Serving as an SDE-III in AWS EC2 Core's Capacity Engineering org.

* Raising the Bar: Became a Doc Bar-Raiser, participating in improving the quality of Amazon's writing culture.

• Cross-Org Collaboration: Spearheaded cross-team, cross-org initiative across 12 engineering groups for attributing and tracing internal launch requests from demand-shaping mechanisms. This allowed the expansion of demand simulation, improved forecasting, analysis, capabilities in instance placement, and improved cloud capacity ordering systems, as well as improving metrics and impact analysis.

• Leadership & Mentoring: Led a team of 4-7 developers owning a Tier-1 service across all AWS regions, driving operational excellence and mentoring in AWS-scale engineering practices while earning trust with stakeholders and delivering results.

• EC2 Compute Supply/Demand Optimization: Owned the execution system for an EC2 demand-shaping system, including architecting a shift from a reactive paradigm to proactively optimizing cloud capacity for expected demand, reducing CapEx and operational overhead, while enhancing service availability. Worked heavily with other Capacity Engineering teams and leaders to deliver a variety of initiatives. Coordinated major projects while designing, implementing, and delegating.

• Operational Impact: Reduced trouble tickets from 550+ to fewer than 50 by instituting iterative process improvements and aligned team around a unified technical vision. Automated graceful degradation during new region builds and improved automation reducing operational load. Service operated at the scale of 170M+ daily requests growing 22% YoY. Improvements over tenure additionally reduced p90 latency by over 50% from 190ms to 90ms despite growing demand. Developed AI-assisted on-call retro report. Efforts reduced the need for KTLO headcount from 2 to 1.
positions.insights: Skills: Architecture · Java · Distributed Systems · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer/Architect
positions.description:
• Technical Acumen: Cloud engineering including Terraform, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Backend development including .Net 6, Microsoft SQL Server, Entity Framework. Frontend development including Angular, Material Design.

• Cloud-Native Transformation: Directed full-stack architecture and migration of a monolithic application to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), integrating CI/CD via Azure DevOps, Terraform, and Helm to enable seamless scalability and compliance, enabling the customer to meet commitments.

• Rapid Delivery & Mentorship: Rescued a stalled 4-year project through hands-on development, mentoring, and best-practice implementations, yielding increased team productivity and sustainable process improvements while encouraging teamwork and respect and earning trust with the client.

• Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborated with clients and internal teams to drive engineering process reforms and ensure timely delivery of critical customer initiatives.

• End-to-End Delivery: - Completed 6-month project as solo developer throughout the entire SDLC process including requirements-gathering, design, feedback loop, implementation, CI/CD, and unit-testing using Angular 13 & .Net 6. Interfaced directly with the customers and key stakeholders to reduce delivery of key EPA reports from months to days.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · Architecture · Azure DevOps · C# · .NET Core · Microsoft Azure · Angular Material · Kubernetes · TypeScript · Git · JavaScript

positions.title: Sofware Engineer III
positions.description:
• Leadership & Mentoring: Led a team of 2-3 developers owning multiple projects, driving operational excellence and mentoring engineers in AWS-scale engineering practices while earning trust with stakeholders through accountability and delivering results.

• Enterprise Applications: Developed multiple rich web applications, implementing distributed architectures for Fortune 500 clients ranging from optimizing clinical trial review management to streamlining financial investment data analysis.

• Innovation & Prototyping: Pioneered augmented reality training tools using Microsoft HoloLens with Unity3D. Engineered innovative solutions to streamline maintenance data processing within the US Navy. Aided development of prototype for US Patent & Trademark Office, resulting in winning the contract.

• Logistics: Built internal product for ingesting and analyzing maintenance & requisition data from disparate systems within the US Navy using Silverlight and C# taking a months-long process down to days.

• Team Growth: Played a key role in expanding contract roles and mentoring junior engineers through delivering results and rigorous implementation of SDLC practices, CI/CD processes, and agile methodologies, earning trust with the customer and expanding contract from 1FTE to 5FTE.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-end Development · Architecture · Azure DevOps · C# · .NET Core · Unity3D · Angular Material · TypeScript · Git · JavaScript

projects.description: Performed the preliminary design, artwork, and implementation for Congruity. Congruity is a game based upon established puzzle mechanics with interesting innovations. It released for iOS, Android, and Windows 10 on Google Play, Amazon App Store, iTunes App Store, and Windows Store.

projects.title: Cockatilt
projects.description:
Did the programming and animation for Cockatilt - a mobile game for Android, Windows 8, and iOS. The game had a successful Kickstarter campaign and by December 1, 2014 released for all app stores. In May of 2015 it was accepted for a Humble Bundle Widget.

The official website can be located at http://www.cockatilt.com

Google Play: goo.gl/Wr5rUF
Amazon App Store: amzn.com/B00NCPJQTQ
Windows 8 Phone: bit.ly/1ursUuY
Windows 8 Tablets: bit.ly/1t92EhG
